name: starlight-community
description: Plan a creation cell's week, review artifact evidence, and prepare consent-aware reflections.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a shared goal into a week of making.
interface.longDescription: A workflow skill for small creation cells: scope a quest, agree on commitments, review artifacts, and prepare a reflection. Produces drafts; external sends and member data access require separate authorization and tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help our creation cell choose one useful artifact for this week, with a realistic commitment and a Friday reflection.
